known.fact: Adjunct teacher at Randers Statsskole, Winter War veteran from the Finnish army, runs the Terrain Sports Club as cover.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Leader of the whole Randers network. Refuses to flee after the arrests, is taken 30 Nov 1943.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Dies attacking a guard to escape a red-hot-stove interrogation at Thorsgade barracks; shot in the back through the window.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: Buried at night in the memorial grove; Pastor Borchsenius forbidden to speak, sings instead. Next day the townspeople cover the grave in red and white flowers.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)
